description: Google Search API: Google Trends interest by region. Where the keywords are searched most: one row per country (worldwide), region (in a country), metro area or city, each keyword's value from 0 to 100 relative to the region with the most interest. Regions without data are left out. Price: 3 credits per call; failed calls are free.

category.description: Google Trends category id (0 = all categories)

from_date.description: Custom range start (YYYY-MM-DD, from 2004-01-01; with `to_date`, not with `time_range`)

geo.description: Country (`US`) or region (`US-CA`); worldwide when left out

keywords.description: Up to 5 keywords to compare, separated by commas

property.description: Which Google search: web, image, news, YouTube or Shopping

resolution.description: Level of the rows; by default countries worldwide and regions in a country (`metro` = US DMA areas)

name: google_trends_interest_by_region
title: Google Trends interest by region
